newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Oklahoma feedlot cattle limited test - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Oklahoma feedlot cattle limited test - USDA.

text.p: Trade was slow in the Panhandle area early Tuesday, with a limited test of slaughter steers and heifers at steady prices, USDA said. Feedlots reporting moderate inquiry from buyers.
Sales reported on 600 Slaughter steers and 600 heifers; 27,800 head confirmed for the week to date which includes 25,800 formulated and 800 previously contracted cattle to be shipped this week.
Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1250 lbs 65.00.
Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1000-1150 lbs 65.00.
